==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 11-17 (Requires 6 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +10% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +10% (Chance:10%)
:[[Marksmanship]] +1 (20% Chance while using [[skills]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Wooden Longbow]].
